categories.main_business_segments: Anhui Huaheng Biotechnology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of bio-based products using synthetic biology technology. Its main product lines include amino acids (alanine series, L-valine, isoleucine, tryptophan, arginine), vitamins (D-calcium pantothenate, D-pantothenol, inositol), bio-based new material monomers (1,3-propanediol, succinic acid), and other products such as malic acid and arbutin. These products serve multiple sectors including intermediates, animal nutrition, daily chemical care, functional food nutrition, and plant nutrition.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced synthetic biology techniques, including gene editing, metabolic engineering, and bioprocess optimization, to construct microbial cell factories for anaerobic fermentation and enzymatic catalysis. It has developed proprietary high-yield strains and fermentation control technologies for L-alanine and L-valine production, achieving international leading levels. The company also integrates AI-driven digital laboratories and high-throughput platforms to enhance R&D efficiency and manufacturing scalability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global Fortune 500 companies and leading domestic enterprises in chemical, pharmaceutical, feed, and agriculture sectors. Notable clients are BASF, Ajinomoto, Nutreco, New Hope Group, Muyuan Foods, Wahaha Group, and Dongpeng Beverage. The products are widely used in animal feed, pharmaceuticals, food additives, cosmetics, and agriculture, targeting both domestic and international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Hefei, Qinhuangdao, Bayannur, Chifeng, and Nanyang. It also has subsidiaries in the United States and Hong Kong, supporting global sales and R&D activities. Overseas sales account for a significant portion of revenue, with exports to Europe, Japan, Korea, Southeast Asia, and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Anhui Huaheng Biotechnology operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the bio-manufacturing supply chain. It focuses on microbial strain development, fermentation production, and downstream product purification and sales. The company also integrates upstream raw material procurement and downstream customer application development, forming a vertically integrated bio-based product supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment, focusing on synthetic biology innovation, strain optimization, fermentation process control, and product diversification. It pursues a 'bio + AI' strategy to accelerate technology development and industrialization. Strategic collaborations with universities and industry leaders aim to develop new bio-based materials and expand applications in textiles, agriculture, and nutrition. The company also prioritizes digital transformation and excellence in manufacturing to enhance operational efficiency and global competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of bio-based chemical products, including amino acids, vitamins, and bio-based monomers. The company operates a direct sales model, engaging with large industrial and commercial customers domestically and internationally. It also benefits from government subsidies and investment income from equity holdings, but product sales constitute the main revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a global leader in bio-based product manufacturing, particularly in L-alanine and L-valine production, holding the largest global market share for L-alanine. Major competitors include domestic firms like Fengyuan Biochemical and Yantai Hengyuan, and international companies such as CJ CheilJedang and BASF. Anhui Huaheng distinguishes itself through advanced fermentation and enzymatic technologies, comprehensive product portfolios, and strong strategic partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.18 billion, representing a 12.37% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 189.5 million, a 57.8% decrease mainly due to increased expenses and price declines in valine products. Total assets reached nearly RMB 5 billion, growing 25.67%, and shareholders' equity increased by 40.38%. The company maintains a robust R&D investment ratio of around 5.7% of revenue, supporting sustained growth and innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Anhui Huaheng Biotechnology offers high-quality, cost-effective bio-based products produced via environmentally friendly and sustainable synthetic biology processes. Its proprietary microbial strains and fermentation technologies enable lower production costs and reduced carbon emissions compared to traditional petrochemical methods. The company’s diversified product matrix and strategic collaborations with global industry leaders provide customers with innovative, green, and reliable solutions tailored to emerging market needs, reinforcing its competitive advantage.
